title: Athelstone of the Oval
description: This pack adds the new athelstone blocks which include bricks and a new way to get perfect green grass anywhere
body:
This pack retexures 12 blocks to add 9 Athelstone Clay blocks, Blood Manure a fertilizer  that used to be used at cricket grounds and a curated pitch and a bare wicket and a wicket for you to craft. Athelstone can be crafted using dirt, water and a shovel or found near beaches.

In the new 1.1 update grab your old turf and build a stadium as cricket bats are a new feature
